analysis: Luma and temporal statistics use downscaled encoded RGB frames inside the specified normalized logical visual ROI.
roi_correction: The specified logical rectangle is the included visual area; pixels outside it are excluded as HUD/subtitle margins. This report supersedes earlier wrong-ROI metrics.
